profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CNF Technologies
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
Agile Defense enables scalable software development by leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD methodologies to enhance deployment efficiency and streamline team collaboration. Contributed to automated deployment pipelines using ArgoCD, Helm charts, and Docker/Podman images while supporting infrastructure monitoring through Rancher. Designed custom AWS AMIs with Packer and Jenkins, ensuring consistency and reliability across cloud environments.  

Previously at IntelliBridge, partnered with the Department of Homeland Security to develop cloud-based platforms supporting immigration processes. Designed secure API systems with Apigee and Java Spring Boot while applying Agile practices for continuous delivery. Holds both a Bachelor's and Master's degree in Computer Science from The University of New Mexico, combining academic expertise with a mission to modernize federal systems.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Played a key role in developing innovative software solutions that enhanced deployment efficiency and cross-team collaboration.
• Deployed and configured ArgoCD across multiple environments, enabling DevOps engineers to automate the deployment of APIs and web applications.
• Designed and maintained Helm charts and Docker/Podman images to support automated deployment to Kubernetes clusters.
• Utilized Rancher to rapidly diagnose and resolve issues in Kubernetes-based APIs and web applications alongside development teams.
• Built and automated custom AWS AMIs using Packer and Jenkins pipelines, improving infrastructure consistency.
• Monitored infrastructure health, ensured high availability, and responded to incidents to maintain system reliability.
• Developed a Java Template Engine (JTE) to standardize and streamline Jenkins pipelines, boosting build efficiency.
• Led knowledge-sharing sessions to promote best practices, foster innovation, and encourage continuous learning across teams.
• Engineered custom CI/CD pipelines, significantly reducing deployment time and improving application stability.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Support Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and Person Centric Identity Services (PCIS) team to create an authoritative source for person information and unique identities about applicants for immigration benefits
• Designed and implemented cloud-based platforms utilizing Python, Java Spring Boot, and AWS. 
• Implement and integrate Apigee proxy to serve different clients, improve and secure APIs systems
• Improved code quality and team efficiency through code reviews and pair programming practices.
• Applied Agile methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle to support continuous integration and delivery.
• Enhanced deployment timelines through innovative workflow optimization, improving efficiency by 30%. 
• Mentored junior developers, fostering a collaborative environment that improved team productivity.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.locationName: 800 N Glebe Rd Suite 700, Arlington, VA 22203
positions.description:
• Supported the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in digitizing paper-based immigration forms for U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS).
• Designed and implemented electronic forms I-821 and I-765 using ReactJs, TypeScript, and Redux, leading to successful online filing.
• Successfully deployed Forms I-821 and I-765 for public online filing, increasing accessibility and efficiency.
• Developed custom application loggers and integrated TypeScript with SAP UI5, improving data analytics for federal agencies.
• Developed enterprise web applications for the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) using the SAP UI5 JavaScript framework.
• Created custom application loggers to collect user interaction data, collaborating with Qlik and backend teams to generate advanced analytics in Qlik Sense.
• Built file preprocessing and upload features using JavaScript and SAP UI5 for secure document handling.
• Integrated TypeScript, Babel, and UI5 Tooling to modernize and streamline SAP UI5 development workflows.
• Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using XSJS and JavaScript, improving system modularity and reusability.
• Researched and integrated modern tools and frameworks to enhance system performance and user experience (UX).
• Accelerated testing through Test-Driven Development (TDD), ensuring robust software quality.  
• Conducted research on emerging technologies, implementing enhancements that significantly improved application performance.
• Successfully apply agile methodology in software development life cycle (SDLC) to support continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a robust YouTube video getter API using Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript.  
• Leveraged Docker and AWS EC2 for efficient deployment and scalability of the application.  
• Enabled users to download or stream both non-decoded and decoded videos across multiple platforms.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Create a WordPress website using Docker and AWS EC2
• http://drspringerwiseandwell.com/

positions.title: R&D Computer Science Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developed innovative web-based applications using cutting-edge front-end technologies like ReactJs, CesiumJs, Babel, and Typescript.  
• Implemented a 3D global web app to visualize all US satellite stations, enhancing data accessibility.  
• Researched and integrated Web Assembly with C/C++, Typescript, and Rust for efficient computation and rendering.  
• Established CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, streamlining testing and deployment processes.
• Built monitoring tools with Grafana and Prometheus to track system health and performance.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an efficient logging stack using AWS services, significantly reducing monthly costs.  
• Utilized Python and AWS CloudFormation to configure and launch services, including Kinesis Data Firehose and ELK stack.  
• Successfully collected and transformed log data from thousands of EC2 instances, enhancing visibility through Kibana dashboards.
